zh-CN.title: 隋唐道教人物与制度资料
zh-CN.subtitle: 人物、宫观与皇室关系的研究档案
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这组资料条目作为研究层文本，帮助观众区分道教人物传记、宫观制度和后世道教谱系叙述。
curatorialDescription: 它不是一部单一古典，而是待编目的研究档案集合；页面会明确显示其来源等级和待核状态。
通过司马承祯、楼观和长安地点，观众可以追问人物、制度和地域传统如何互相塑造。

en.title: Sui–Tang Daoist institutional records
en.subtitle: A research archive of figures, institutions and court relations
en.shortSummary: This research-layer text collection helps distinguish Daoist biographies, institutional history and later genealogical narratives.
curatorialDescription: It is not one ancient classic but a pending research archive; the page will show its evidence grade and review state.
Through Sima Chengzhen, Louguan and Chang'an, visitors can ask how figures, institutions and regional traditions shaped one another.
